title: Whole of India and the Gilja Pathans

blocks.text: The narrative now widens from individual intrigue to a subcontinental struggle, explicitly signaling Episode 128 and the shift to Whole of India and the Gilja Pathans. The concern is no longer only Gazdi's character, but the effort to recover authority across Hindustan after repeated upheaval.

In that larger frame, Mughal and Pathan forces united in response to Maratha advance and political fragmentation. Lahore is re-entered with strength, and the story presents the coalition as an attempt to restore order by consolidating Muslim power under renewed leadership.

The proposed arrangement imagines three ministers and a Kandhari sovereign overseeing the realm, a formula meant to stabilize what war had broken apart. This page therefore serves as a transition from Gazdi's failings to the broad imperial contest that will dominate the next episode.
